title: Glowing flower pot
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff7c0' stop-opacity='0.55'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#fff7c0' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <circle cx='50' cy='45' r='45' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- flowers -->
  <g>
    <line x1='50' y1='62' x2='50' y2='38' stroke='#7ee06a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='52' x2='36' y2='42' stroke='#7ee06a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='56' x2='64' y2='46' stroke='#7ee06a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- left leaf -->
    <ellipse cx='34' cy='48' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#5fd04e' transform='rotate(-30 34 48)'/>
    <!-- right leaf -->
    <ellipse cx='66' cy='52' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#5fd04e' transform='rotate(30 66 52)'/>
    <!-- top flower -->
    <g>
      <circle cx='50' cy='27' r='5' fill='#ff6fa8'/>
      <circle cx='50' cy='19' r='4.5' fill='#ff8fc0'/>
      <circle cx='57' cy='23' r='4.5' fill='#ff8fc0'/>
      <circle cx='55' cy='31' r='4.5' fill='#ff8fc0'/>
      <circle cx='45' cy='31' r='4.5' fill='#ff8fc0'/>
      <circle cx='43' cy='23' r='4.5' fill='#ff8fc0'/>
      <circle cx='50' cy='25' r='3.5' fill='#ffe45e'/>
    </g>
    <!-- left flower bud -->
    <circle cx='33' cy='38' r='4' fill='#ff9ad0'/>
    <circle cx='33' cy='38' r='2' fill='#ffe45e'/>
    <!-- right flower bud -->
    <circle cx='67' cy='42' r='4' fill='#ff9ad0'/>
    <circle cx='67' cy='42' r='2' fill='#ffe45e'/>
  </g>
  <!-- pot rim -->
  <rect x='31' y='62' width='38' height='8' rx='3' fill='#ffb35c'/>
  <rect x='31' y='62' width='38' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ffd08f'/>
  <!-- pot body -->
  <path d='M34 70 L66 70 L61 90 Q50 95 39 90 Z' fill='#e8763a'/>
  <path d='M40 72 L46 72 L45 88 L39 87 Z' fill='#ff9a5c'/>
  <!-- pot glow accents -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='80' r='3' fill='#ffe45e'/>
</svg>
